result.summary: Found 2 visual issues. The most noticeable is that the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the restaurant feed, and there is also a horizontally scrolled card that is clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar sits on top of the content, partially covering the lower restaurant card and its badge area.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content equal to the nav bar height so cards are not obscured behind the fixed footer.

issues.description: The rightmost card in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the screen edge, making the carousel look cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase horizontal padding or ensure the carousel shows cards with a clearer partial preview so the clipped edge looks intentional.
